response.sql: WITH matched_records AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as count FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count FROM matched_records) SELECT AVG(mr.count) as avg_count, AVG(mr.count - ac.avg_count) as avg_excess FROM matched_records mr CROSS JOIN avg_count ac WHERE mr.count > ac.avg_count
